notes: Recorded 217 approved courses (15 + 46 + 21 + 53 + 39 + 43 by theme in page order: Access, inclusion and opportunity, Improving population health, health systems and capacity, Promoting innovation and entrepreneurship, Science and technology for development, Strengthening peace, security and governance, Strengthening resilience and response to crises) at 47 universities (48 spellings, Brunel is spelled two ways), matching the 47 participating universities stored; the page states no total. Read from the page's own tables, not from a summary.
A university's name is kept as the page writes it: Brunel appears as 'Brunel University of London' in four tables and as 'Brunel University London' once (Innovation and entrepreneurship table).
One course name was written 'MSC Renewable Energy, Enterprise and Management' on the page; recorded as 'MSc ...' (capitalisation only).

Four courses carry a page note that the application system uses a different name; each is recorded in the course's detail: LSTM MSc One Health in Tropical & Infectious Disease, Cranfield MSc Water and Wastewater Processes, Bournemouth MSc Resilience and Disaster Management, LSTM MSc Humanitarian Action. The stored record counted five flagged courses; the page now shows four.

Course-specific preferences from the contact-details page: Bournemouth MSc Public Health (would prefer not to recruit CSC applicants from Ghana, India, Nigeria or Pakistan; no restriction for other Bournemouth courses) and Oxford MSt Diplomatic Studies (preference for underrepresented African countries). Bangor gives preference to candidates who are residents of Uganda and Kenya and work with The Windle Trust (applies to the university's places, not one course).
The first pass stored the first 25 courses (themes 1 and 2 partly); this list supersedes it.
not_stated: A stated total number of courses or of participating universities on the eligible-courses page
